name: MontyPay
author: Technical Team | MontyPay

sections.description:
This plugin adds the MontyPay to WooCommerce, enabling merchants to process payments securely through MontyPay’s payment platform.

Features

  • Bank card payments on hosted page
  • iFrame and non-iFrame card payments
  • Recurring payments support
  • Server-to-server (S2S) processing
  • Digital wallet payments
  • Apple Pay support
  • Stripe-based payment flow support
  • Payment icons with enable/disable options

No sensitive card details are stored on your server. All sensitive payment data is handled by MontyPay’s secure infrastructure.

External Services

This plugin relies on a third-party external payment service called MontyPay to process payments.

What the service is and what it is used for

MontyPay is a payment service provider used to securely process online payments made through this plugin.
The service is required to create payment sessions, initiate transactions, redirect users to secure checkout pages, and receive payment status confirmations.

What data is sent and when

When a user initiates a payment through this plugin, the plugin communicates with MontyPay’s external APIs and services. The data sent may include:

  • Transaction amount and currency
  • Order or reference ID
  • Customer details required for payment processing (such as name, email address, and billing information, depending on configuration)
  • Technical data required to complete the transaction (such as transaction identifiers, callback URLs, and session tokens)

This data is sent only when a payment is created, processed, or verified and is necessary for the payment functionality to work correctly.

The plugin does not store or process payment card details. All sensitive payment information is handled directly by MontyPay’s secure infrastructure.

External service endpoints

This plugin may connect to the following MontyPay domains and API endpoints in order to function correctly:

  • https://api.montypay.com/post
  • https://checkout.montypay.com/api/v1/session
  • https://mm-core.montypay.com/api/v1/transaction/checkout
  • https://checkout.montypay.com/*
  • .montypay.com/

These endpoints are used to create payment sessions, process transactions, redirect users to hosted checkout pages, and receive transaction status updates.

Terms of service and privacy policy

MontyPay’s handling of data is governed by its own legal documents:

  • Terms and Conditions:
    https://montypay.com/terms-and-conditions

  • Privacy Policy:
    https://montypay.com/privacy-policy

By using this plugin, you acknowledge that payment-related data will be transmitted to MontyPay for the purpose of processing payments, in accordance with MontyPay’s terms and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  4. Enable MontyPay Payment.
  5. Enter your merchant key and password.
sections.faq:
How do I get the merchant key and password?

Please reach out to our MontyPay Sales team to obtain your credentials.

Does this plugin handle card information?

No. All sensitive data is processed securely on MontyPay servers.

Does it support recurring payments?

Yes. Recurring payments are supported.
